Class SwerveModule

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.swerve.SwerveModule
public class SwerveModule extends Object
Swerve Module

SwerveModule coordinates the drive motor (velocity control) and the azimuth (steer) motor (position control) that make up one corner of a swerve drivetrain. On construction it reads the absolute encoder and seeds the azimuth relative encoder so the wheel starts at the correct angle. Each periodic cycle you call setSwerveModuleState(SwerveModuleVelocity) to command both motors, and getState() / getPosition() to read back the current wheel velocity and heading.

Typical usage

In almost every case you should not instantiate SwerveModule directly. Instead, pass one SwerveModuleConfig per corner to SwerveDriveConfig and let SwerveDrive create and manage the modules internally: 

SwerveDriveConfig driveConfig = new SwerveDriveConfig()
    .withSwerveModuleConfig(frontLeft, frontRight, backLeft, backRight);

SwerveDrive swerveDrive = new SwerveDrive(driveConfig);

Direct instantiation (advanced)

If you need direct access to a module for example when writing unit tests or custom characterisation routines you can construct one from a fully-configured SwerveModuleConfig: 

// Assumes 'frontLeftConfig' has already been built with drive/steer motors,
// wheel radius, module location, absolute encoder offset, and telemetry name.
SwerveModule frontLeft = new SwerveModule(frontLeftConfig);

// Command a specific state (angle + speed)
SwerveModuleVelocity desiredState = new SwerveModuleVelocity(1.5, Rotation2d.fromDegrees(45));
frontLeft.setSwerveModuleState(desiredState);

// Read back current state
SwerveModuleVelocity current = frontLeft.getState();

    • SwerveModule

      public SwerveModule(SwerveModuleConfig config)
      Create a SwerveModule.
      Parameters:
      config - SwerveModuleConfig for the module.
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the drive or azimuth motor controller is not set in the config.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the config has no telemetry name.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the config has no location.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the azimuth motor controller has an external encoder configured but external feedback is not enabled with withUseExternalFeedbackEncoder(true).

    • setSwerveModuleState

      public org.wpilib.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleVelocity setSwerveModuleState(org.wpilib.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleVelocity state, org.wpilib.units.measure.Force feedforwardForce)
      Set the SwerveModuleVelocity of the module with an additional drive wheel feedforward Force applied on top, e.g. from a PathPlanner set-point generator.
      Parameters:
      state - State to set.
      feedforwardForce - Feedforward Force applied at the drive wheel, in the direction of travel of the requested state. It is reversed along with the drive direction when optimization turns the wheel around, and scaled by the cosine compensation factor when that is enabled.
      Returns:
      The optimized SwerveModuleVelocity.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the drive motor has no mechanism circumference configured (e.g. via SwerveModuleConfig.withWheelRadius(org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance)).
